verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a structured llms.txt at docs.typesafe.ai that links to the docs pages, and those pages are served as Markdown (.md). TypeSafe also ships an agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other agent environments that gives coding agents full context on the API, plus a dedicated coding-agents docs page. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or single-file full-docs bundle, and no independent hands-on report of an agent consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
